O.content: The title literally reads "Shrinking Population of City A from 2010 to 2015".

B.text: If the chart title is an authoritative statement of the City A population trend for 2010-2015 and the workflow maps a stated shrinking trend to decline response, select the decline-response route.
B.conditions: Applies only if the title is intended to override or correct the plotted line; neither authority nor conflict-resolution policy is supplied.

O.content: The title literally contains "Shrinking Population," while the blue line's endpoint at 2015 is higher on the page than its endpoint at 2010.

B.text: If contradictory chart signals cannot be resolved and no supplied policy specifies a route for conflicting or insufficient evidence, routine monitoring is a possible conservative route only if the workflow permits it for unresolved trends.
B.conditions: Requires a workflow rule allowing routine monitoring for unresolved evidence; no such rule is supplied.

O.location: plot area, at x-axis ticks 2010 and 2015
O.content: A single blue line begins at the 2010 tick aligned with the y-axis tick labeled "2,000" and ends at the 2015 tick aligned with the y-axis tick labeled "3,000".

The horizontal axis is visibly labeled "Year" and has printed ticks from "2010" through "2015"; the vertical axis is visibly labeled "Population" and its printed values increase upward from "0" to "3,500".

B.text: If the blue line is the dashboard's total-population series, the horizontal axis maps left-to-right positions to the printed years, and the vertical axis increases upward as labeled, then a line endpoint aligned with a higher y-axis tick at the later year represents population growth; if the routing workflow maps observed growth to growth planning, select the growth-planning route.
B.conditions: Assumes the plotted line is City A total population for the stated period and that visual axis encoding, rather than the title wording, governs the population values. No explicit routing policy is supplied.
